summary: Added meterbill/money.py (context-free exact rounding) and routed all rounding/fixed-place formatting through it; removed the context line, kept CLI output identical (verified by differential fuzzing vs the original) and added tests/test_money.py. Preserved quirks: batch worker threads rounded half-even (band charges, per-kWh price) while other paths round half-up, now explicit via keyword-only method params; whole-currency payable never shows -0; 28-digit context precision overflow on enormous values is not reproduced.
